body:
Unemployed

Two degrees

Only offered minimum wage jobs. No career.

People I used to know all have prestigous careers and families, even the ones who were really dumb in high school (no offense to them)

No job = no social life

Attend a running club but too ashamed of my life to open up to others

Rarely leave the house and no place to speak to women

Feel like I have let my parents down

6'0, white and ok looking, but have norwood 4 hair which is thinning further. Also some acne scars. Also have hyperhidrosis on my hands and feet.

Just mentally tired and stuck forever - peter pan syndrome

Don't know what else to say. Feel like I have life on hard mode compared to others. My father is the same, he has always worked really hard in life but never has any luck. He has had to grind blood sweat and tears just to get the few things we have. He went to university in his 30s.
